correctness.rationale: For any nonempty erasure mask, retained edges form e disjoint paths. Each path has exactly one doubleton reading (all sums one), with 2^v-2 singleton readings; all other inputs give unique outputs. Tensoring components proves complete powers-of-two list histogram. The strict inequality (2^(v+1)-1)^2>(2^v-1)(2^(v+2)-1) gives sharp balanced/unbalanced masks; counting masks with a marked erased edge gives the n/e coefficient extraction. The exact count of cyclic nonadjacent e-subsets gives birthday threshold exp(-c^2). Standalone Python checked 2,032 masks and 1,396,040 source instances for all n=3..10; it is evidence, not infinite proof. Boundary cases e=2, e=n, isolated paths and the e>n/2 threshold are included.
